SELECT u.* FROM sys_user u
INNER JOIN sys_user_dept ud ON ud.user_id = u.id AND ud.is_deleted = 0 AND ud.dept_id = #{deptId}
WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.user_category = 'backend'
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
AND u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{nickname}, '%')
AND u.status = #{status}
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC
